title: Atomic Mass / Relative Atomic Mass
notes:
Atomic Mass Standards

Hydrogen Standard: Ratio to mass of 1 H atom.
Carbon-12 Standard (IUPAC): Mass relative to 1/12th of a C-12 atom.
1 amu = 1.66 × 10⁻²⁴ g (approx. mass of 1 proton).
summary: Historical and modern carbon-12 atomic mass standards.
